p5_b0.ocr: In the JPMorgan Chase Wealth Management Overview for January 2024, the Assets Under Management (AUM) totals CNY 1 trillion, with a growth rate of 4.5%. The High Net Worth client segment holds CNY 500 billion, reflecting a change of 5.2%, with 10,000 new clients contributing to total revenue of CNY 10 billion and net income of CNY 2 billion. Retail Clients account for CNY 300 billion, up by 3.8%, with 5,000 new clients generating CNY 6 billion in revenue and net income of CNY 1 billion. Institutional Clients represent CNY 200 billion, exhibiting a growth rate of 4.1%, attracting 2,000 new clients and yielding CNY 4 billion in total revenue and CNY 800 million in net income.

p5_b1.ocr: The market performance indicates an average AUM growth of 10% over one year, with a client retention rate of 92% and a satisfaction rate of 88%. Future projections anticipate an AUM of CNY 1.2 trillion, with a growth rate of 7% and 20,000 new clients, leading to total revenue of CNY 30 billion.
